detected_by: git status --short after a git stash push/pop showed two modified files I never touched
impact: A second agent is writing src/rules_core/equipment_resolver.rs and apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/character_hub.rs in the same working tree while I hold src/rules_core/pilot_compute*.rs. Their in-flight work moved cargo test --lib from 1338 to 1349 (+6 theirs, +5 mine) and produced one transient failure in equipment_resolver::tests::key_lookup_and_cost_resolution_never_disagree_for_any_catalog_key that did not reproduce on three reruns, so my measured counts cannot be attributed to my change alone without subtracting theirs.
resolution: Stopped using git stash (it would have swallowed their work), left their files untouched, and attributed counts explicitly in the final report
summary: Concurrent writer in the same working tree contaminates test-count baselines

reason: The measured defect was the missing size term on four cells. Folding a second, unmeasured correction into the same change would make it impossible to attribute which change moved a shipped number, and the brief's expected values (Goblin CMD 16) are for a build carrying none of those bonuses. Both gaps are named in the engine's own explanation prose and doc comments rather than silently implied.
revisit: The cycle that grounds flat-footed AC in the engine
summary: CMD's non-size AC bonuses and flat-footed AC left for a later cycle
what: CMD does not yet include the deflection/dodge/insight/luck/morale/profane/sacred bonuses to AC that PF1 also applies to it; the engine grounds several (Dodge +1, Brawler AC Bonus, Inquisitor Protection judgment). Flat-footed AC is also still computed in CharacterSheet.tsx rather than the engine.

reason: previewData.ts is outside this run's granted write scope. The em dash is the honest rendering for absent engine data and matches deriveRaceTraits' existing convention; the desktop path is unaffected because load_saved_character always carries the records.
summary: Browser-preview sample sheet shows em dashes for the three new engine cells
what: apps/desktop/src/characterHub/previewData.ts was not given defense.touch_armor_class / combat.combat_maneuver_bonus / defense.combat_maneuver_defense explanation records, so the browser preview (no Tauri runtime) now renders those three tiles as an em dash.

detected_by: A screenshot I took immediately after typing showed the other agent's character name, and their saved character's PP moved between two of my captures
impact: I drove the shared headless desktop app (DISPLAY :99, driver.sh) while a second agent was mid-verification on the same instance: driver.sh launch is documented as stopping any previous run, and my typed character name landed in a create form the other agent then re-rendered with its own value. No repo file was affected; the interference is confined to the shared X session and one throwaway test character.
resolution: Stopped issuing driver.sh subcommands, drove the already-running window read-only via xdotool/import for one screenshot, and left the app running rather than calling stop
summary: Two agents cannot drive the one headless desktop instance at once
